query:
with placement as (
            update product_reservation_placement_tails
                set placement_tail = placement_tail + 1
            where product_id = $2
            returning old.placement_tail
        )
        insert into product_reservation_queuers (user_id, product_id, placement)
        select $1 as user_id, $2 as product_id, placement.placement_tail as placement
        from placement
